sources.title: GLM-4.5-Flash official model guide
sources.evidence: Fresh complete Markdown reopened October 27, 2026. The exact original Flash page describes text input/output, 128K context, 96K output, optional thinking and Function Calling, with no total/active parameter count or named base checkpoint. Its notice schedules January 30, 2026 retirement and automatic routing to GLM-4.7-Flash.

sources.title: July 28, 2025 archived original GLM-4.5-Flash launch guide
sources.publisher: Zhipu / BigModel, preserved by Internet Archive
sources.evidence: Retrieved archived HTML directly. July 28 12:39:29 UTC snapshot explicitly calls glm-4.5-flash newly launched and free to use, with 128K context, 96K output, text input/output, optional thinking and Function Call. Benchmark material separately names GLM-4.5 and GLM-4.5-Air; it does not say Flash equals either model.

sources.title: BigModel model and product release log
sources.evidence: July 28, 2025 entry announces the GLM-4.5 series. Used with the same-day exact Flash launch guide, not alone to transfer the family date to Flash.

sources.title: GLM-4.5 official API family guide
sources.evidence: Fresh complete Markdown reopened October 27, 2026. Flash is a separate entry described as free and strong at reasoning, coding and agents; the numerical overview explicitly names GLM-4.5 at 355B total/32B active and Air at 106B/12B. No named unchanged base or post-training lineage maps Flash to either. Visually inspected the linked parameter-efficiency plot: it labels standard GLM-4.5 and Air, not Flash.

sources.title: GLM-4.5: Agentic, Reasoning, and Coding (ARC) Foundation Models
sources.evidence: Re-read full original HTML text fetched October 27, 2026 (95,255 characters). Table 1 explicitly gives total/activated parameters for standard GLM-4.5 (355B/32B), Air (106B/12B), DeepSeek-V3 and Kimi K2; its convention includes MTP and excludes embeddings/output layers. No occurrence of Flash appears anywhere in the full text, so neither its own-model nor comparison rows establish original Flash counts.

sources.title: Official Z.ai public model repository inventory
sources.evidence: Read 154 public repository entries. GLM-4.5, Air, Base, Air-Base, FP8, Air-FP8 and vision variants appear, but no GLM-4.5-Flash checkpoint. This supports keeping the hosted-only classification; absence alone does not prove Flash is a service tier of another model.

sources.title: Official GLM-4.5 model card
sources.evidence: Fresh official model card reopened October 27, 2026. Model Introduction and Model Downloads name standard, Air, Base and FP8 variants at 355B-A32B or 106B-A12B. They contain no original Flash checkpoint or named-base mapping. Counts and MIT grants are not transferred to the hosted Flash entry.

sources.title: Later GLM-4.7-Flash official model card
sources.evidence: Fresh official successor card reopened October 27, 2026. It explicitly identifies GLM-4.7-Flash as a 30B-A3B MoE model. The benchmark table compares that successor, Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 and GPT-OSS-20B; it has no original 4.5-Flash row or active-count column. The card links the GLM-4.5 paper but does not identify 4.5-Flash as an unchanged base.

sources.title: Z.ai Terms of Use and API service terms
sources.evidence: Section V reserves model parameters, algorithms, code and architecture IP to Z.ai. Additional API terms grant limited service access without transferring ownership. Supports a descriptive proprietary classification for this hosted model, not a named checkpoint license.

sources.title: Original Dify Z.ai integration for exact glm-4.5-flash identifier
sources.evidence: Pinned integration implementation assigns glm-4.5-flash context_size 131072 and max_tokens 98304, matching the native guide’s 128K/96K convention. This is original integration evidence for explicit integer limits, not evidence of undisclosed model internals.

sources.title: GLM-4.7-Flash open and free: January 19, 2026 original release notice
sources.evidence: Fresh original page retrieved October 27, 2026. The January 19 release states 30B total and 3B activated parameters specifically for GLM-4.7-Flash and says it replaces GLM-4.5-Flash on BigModel. It calls 4.5-Flash the previous-generation free language model, schedules its January 30 retirement and request rerouting, and gives no unchanged-base lineage or historical 4.5-Flash size.

name.note: Exact dedicated model title and historical API identifier.

developer.note: Z.ai is the international developer brand; the native BigModel documentation is published by Zhipu.

family.note: Retain the existing normalized GLM Flash family key for the explicitly named Flash variant; this grouping does not imply a shared checkpoint or parameter count with other Flash models.

release_date.note: Exact Flash guide was archived July 28, 2025 and explicitly says newly launched and free to use. Same-day native series release log corroborates launch timing. This is dated public availability evidence, not a repository creation date or a later international provider listing.

open_weights.note: The exact original Flash is documented as a hosted API model. No corresponding public checkpoint or explicit identity with standard/Air open checkpoints was found in the checked official inventory and model cards. Free API use does not establish open weights.

license.note: Descriptive hosted-service classification supported by API terms. No Flash-specific weight license was found; standard/Air MIT grants cannot be inherited without an exact model mapping.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 review found no published nominal total for original GLM-4.5-Flash or explicit unchanged named-base lineage. Standard GLM-4.5 355B and Air 106B are separately identified; the later release assigns 30B to replacement GLM-4.7-Flash only. Retain null because exact-model evidence is absent, not because a tensor census is required.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 review separately checked activated counts, the later original GLM-4.5 report Table 1 and successor benchmark table. No exact original Flash row or named unchanged-base relationship supports an active count. The 32B standard, 12B Air and 3B successor figures belong to other models; no dense-equals-active inference is made.

architecture.note: Optional thinking is inference behavior, not a topology disclosure. Primary research searches and later report/card checks did not identify Flash-specific Transformer or MoE architecture. The MoE descriptions name standard/Air or the later 4.7-Flash.

context_window.note: Original native Flash documentation reports 128K context and 96K output. Pinned original integration explicitly resolves those as 131072 and 98304. Retain the original model limit; do not substitute the successor endpoint limit after rerouting.

modalities.note: Native exact-model tables explicitly list text input and text output. Tool browsing does not add visual input modality.

reasoning.note: Exact-model guide documents hybrid reasoning and thinking.type enabled/disabled.

tool_call.note: Exact-model guide explicitly lists Function Calling and tool-use integration.

description.value: Hosted GLM text model with optional reasoning and function calling.
description.note: Replaces vague speed/efficiency wording with documented interface behavior, without implying undisclosed architecture or an open checkpoint.

patch.description: Hosted GLM text model with optional reasoning and function calling.
patch.notes: Original GLM-4.5-Flash was publicly documented on July 28, 2025. Total and active parameters remain undisclosed; no named-base relationship establishes inheritance from standard GLM-4.5 or Air. Architecture is also undisclosed. Free API access does not establish open weights. BigModel announced January 30, 2026 retirement and rerouting to GLM-4.7-Flash; that successor’s 30B/3B counts do not describe the original model. The notice is specific to BigModel.

summary: Fresh October 27 parameter re-audit retains total and active counts as undisclosed after reopening original guides, model cards, the GLM-4.5 report and the January 2026 successor release. Standard/Air counts and successor 30B/3B cannot be inherited without an explicit unchanged-base relationship. The original report’s other twelve assessments are preserved, including July 28, 2025 release, original context, hosted-only classification and BigModel-specific retirement distinction.

parameter_reaudit.outcome: Retain parameters_b=null and active_parameters_b=null, both undisclosed, after separate fresh review; no supported nominal original Flash count or named unchanged base found.

fresh_originals.finding: Exact original Flash guide gives behavior/limits and retirement, no model count or base identity.
Separate Flash entry; 355B/32B and 106B/12B sentences explicitly name standard and Air.
Visually inspected official Model Parameters (B) plot; standard and Air points, no original Flash point.
Full report contains no Flash occurrence. Table 1 has explicit Total/Activated Parameters rows but only standard, Air, DeepSeek-V3 and Kimi K2.
Named model-size rows cover standard/Air/Base/FP8, not original Flash; no applicable post-training lineage.
Successor is explicitly 30B-A3B; later benchmark comparison contains no 4.5-Flash row.
January 19 original announcement assigns 30B/3B to replacement 4.7-Flash and gives January 30 original-model retirement; replacement is not an unchanged-base statement.

parameter_reaudit.lineage_review: No original source identifies GLM-4.5-Flash as a fine-tune, post-trained version or structurally unchanged variant of a specified standard/Air/successor checkpoint. Replacement and endpoint rerouting alone do not establish historical checkpoint identity.
parameter_reaudit.search_findings: Eight bounded English/Chinese searches separately covered total count, activated count, named-base/post-training/distillation lineage and later original research comparisons. No additional qualifying exact-model count or lineage was found. Secondary catalog hits sometimes repeat the standard/Air paragraph under a Flash title; the primary paragraph explicitly names those other models, so those repetitions were not adopted.
parameter_reaudit.access_limitations: The web tool rejected Markdown content and timed out on the Chinese release, but direct original fetches all returned HTTP 200 and were read. The parameter plot query-string URL returned 403; the same original asset without transformation query returned 200 and was visually inspected. Fresh fetch metadata is /tmp/parameter-549-review/manifest.json; the full paper fetch is recorded in /tmp/remaining-parameter-primary-cache/manifest.json. Historical archived s2 evidence is preserved from the earlier audit and was not claimed as freshly fetched in this pass.
parameter_reaudit.remaining_uncertainty: Both counts remain unknown for the original model. The checked sources do not establish a nominal count, applicable later research-table convention or named-base inference; this is not proof that no disclosure exists elsewhere.
